a: Ruby is a dynamic, object-oriented language emphasizing developer happiness.
Ruby on Rails is a full-stack web framework following convention over configuration.
Rails organizes apps into Models, Views, and Controllers.
Active Record maps tables to classes and rows to objects.
config/routes.rb maps URLs to controller actions.
Migrations version and apply database schema changes.
Gems are reusable Ruby libraries managed with Bundler.
Blocks are anonymous chunks of code passed to methods (do...end or {}).
Symbols are immutable identifiers often used as hash keys (:name).
rails console opens an interactive shell with the app environment loaded.
